description: DR-264 run-time probe (one block of 64 queries, no decision), class correctness: recall@10 of sign-bit candidates, variant A (symmetric Hamming) and variant B (asymmetric int4 query codes), at 10, 20, 40 and 80 times k, rescored exactly with VectorStore.rescore, on a float32 and an int8 store of 100,000 pinned AG News train texts, against the exact search of the same store, with the first 64 AG News test texts as queries. Bits and orders are checked against fse._reference_bits. No timing.
